description: This file provides helper methods as extensions to the CanvasWindowController class, focusing on session key sanitization, JavaScript string literal encoding, frame saving/loading, all within a macOS application context.

classes.name: CanvasWindowController
classes.description: An extension providing helper static functions related to session key sanitization, JavaScript literal encoding, and frame persistence for CanvasWindowController.

methods.name: sanitizeSessionKey
methods.description: Sanitizes a session key string by trimming whitespace and replacing invalid characters with underscores.

methods.name: jsStringLiteral
methods.description: Encodes a string as a JSON string literal, escaping necessary characters.

methods.name: jsOptionalStringLiteral
methods.description: Encodes an optional string as a JavaScript string literal or null.

methods.name: storedFrameDefaultsKey
methods.description: Constructs a UserDefaults key for storing frame data based on a sanitized session key.

methods.name: loadRestoredFrame
methods.description: Loads a saved frame (NSRect) from UserDefaults for a given session key, verifying minimum size constraints.

methods.name: storeRestoredFrame
methods.description: Stores the frame (NSRect) into UserDefaults for a specific session key.
